messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

function.name: connectBluetooth
function.description: Establishes a connection to a Bluetooth device using its name. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

device_name.description: The name of the Bluetooth device to connect to.

timeout.description: The number of seconds to attempt a connection before timing out.

auto_reconnect.description: Whether to automatically attempt to reconnect if the connection is lost.

message.content:
Below is a concise list of the long‑weekend holidays that Canadians can take advantage of in 2023.  
(“Long weekend” means the holiday falls on a weekday and the adjacent weekend days give you a 3‑day break.)

| Holiday | Date (2023) | Observed (if different) | Long‑Weekend? | Notes |
|---------|-------------|--------------------------|---------------|-------|
| **New Year’s Day** | Jan 1 (Sunday) | — | **No** | Already a weekend. |
| **Family Day** | Feb 20 (Monday) | — | **Yes** | Provincial (Alberta, BC, SK, ON, etc.). |
| **Good Friday** | Mar 31 (Friday) | — | **Yes** | Many provinces observe; gives Fri‑Sun break. |
| **Victoria Day** | May 22 (Monday) | — | **Yes** | National holiday. |
| **Canada Day** | Jul 1 (Saturday) | Observed Jul 3 (Monday) | **Yes** | Sat‑Sun‑Mon break. |
| **Labour Day** | Sep 4 (Monday) | — | **Yes** | National holiday. |
| **Thanksgiving** | Oct 9 (Monday) | — | **Yes** | National holiday. |
| **Remembrance Day** | Nov 11 (Monday) | — | **Yes** | National holiday. |
| **Christmas** | Dec 25 (Monday) | — | **Yes** | National holiday. |
| **Boxing Day** | Dec 26 (Tuesday) | — | **No** | Tuesday only. |

**Key take‑away:**  
- The most common long weekends in Canada for 2023 are **Family Day (Feb 20)**, **Good Friday (Mar 31)**, **Victoria Day (May 22)**, **Canada Day (Jul 1/Jul 3)**, **Labour Day (Sep 4)**, **Thanksgiving (Oct 9)**, **Remembrance Day (Nov 11)**, and **Christmas (Dec 25)**.  
- These dates give you a 3‑day break (Mon‑Tue or Fri‑Sun or Sat‑Sun‑Mon).  

Feel free to let me know if you’d like the provincial variations (e.g., Family Day dates differ in Quebec, Manitoba, etc.) or if you need the same information for another year!
